description: Variation of condition 2 (approved plans) to allow the amendments to position of windows of planning permission 00083/47/P4 approved 19/03/2021 for the demolition of existing two-storey terraced house and erection of a new two-storey house
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of the original permission 00083/47/P4 whih was approved 19/03/2021.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (13/H/2735/101 Rev A, 13/H/2735/102, Energy Statement dated June 2019 and Design and Access Statement dated August 2015 (received 7 May 2019) & 13/H/2735/103 Rev F (received 24 December 2021)) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - No development shall take place until samples of the materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the hereby permitted have been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority. Development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details

Condition : 4 - Notwithstanding the provisions of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development Order) 1995 (or any order revoking or re-enacting that order) no enlargement of the premises or any additional structures/buildings within the curtilage of the site shall be carried out.

Condition : 5 - No additional windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the side walls of the house hereby approved and no additional doors inserted in the building without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 6 - No demolition or construction work shall take place on the site except between the hours of 8:00am to 6:00pm on Mondays to Friday and 9 :00am to 1:00pm on Saturdays and none shall take place on Sundays and Public Holidays without the prior agreement of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 7 - The use hereby permitted shall not be begun until details of the arrangements for storing of waste and recycled materials have been submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority. The arrangements for storing waste and recycled materials shall not be carried out otherwise than in accordance with any approval given and shall be completed before any part of the accommodation hereby permitted is occupied.

Condition : 8 - Prior to first occupation of the development hereby approved, a detailed plan showing the parking arrangements and hard and soft landscaping to the front of the house must be submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority, and these details shall be carried out, as approved, prior to first occupation of the dwelling. The details shall include a pedestrian path to the front door; a porous hardstanding to prevent run-off onto the public highway; a 4.8m deep x 2.4m wide parking space; a low wall or fence measuring no more than 600mm high at either side of the crossover (to minimise harm to neighbouring properties) and soft landscaping details to enhance the street scene.
